assertions.notes: Round-1 failure fixed. Public channel: D1 returns status=closed with the closed object (reason special_day + the public note) and 0 slots; D2 returns status=online_closed with 0 slots and the onlineClosed object. Operator channel: D1 returns 0 slots with closed=true and dayState={state:'closed',name,note}; D2 still returns 141 slots with onlineClosed=true and dayState.state='online_closed'. Extra staff-booking behavior: a 19:00 party-2 booking on the closed D1 is refused 409 closed_day with a plain message (checked the raw body for 'Failed query', 'insert into', 'SQLITE', 'D1_ERROR', 'SqliteError' - none present) and the specialDay name/note in the details; the same booking with overbook:true + overbookReason succeeds 201 and the response carries warnings=[{code:'closed_day'}]; a booking on the online_closed D2 succeeds 201 with warnings=[] (no override needed).
assertions.limitations: One phrasing in the round-2 brief ('a booking on an online_closed day ... the response carries a closed-day flag') does not match the implemented/expected shape: the 201 booking response has warnings=[] and no closedDay field; the online-closed day flag is exposed by the operator availability payload (onlineClosed=true, dayState.state='online_closed'), which is what the App booking sheet reads. The fix's own route tests assert warnings=[] for this case, and the validation contract only requires operator availability to return slots for D2, so this is recorded as an observation, not a failure. The staff-booking checks were done through the API; the App booking-sheet half is r2-app-sheet's assertion.

assertions.notes: Round-1 failure fixed. The decisive staff-channel check is the area-scoped operator availability: with a live guest hold on the last table of R2A-Area, 19:00 flips to available=false with held=true, heldTableIds=[R2A-T1] and suggestedTableIds=[] (round 1 returned available=true and suggested the held table). Unscoped, the held table is still withheld from suggestions and flagged held=true while the slot stays available through other tables. Guest channel: a second hold for the same slot+area is refused 409 slot_unavailable while the hold is live, the public availability 19:00 entry moves off R2A-Area to a fallback area, and after release and after expiry the 19:00 entry is offered in R2A-Area again and a fresh hold succeeds (201). Expiry half: the hold lapsed (3-minute hold_minutes), was already ignored by the availability read before the sweep, the tick marked it expired (expire_holds ok 1) and deactivated its occupancy; no slot was lost. hold_minutes was set to 3 through the setup settings API for the test (v66 7 -> v67 3) and restored to 7 (v68). The temporary R2A-Area/R2A-T1 fixture was archived afterwards.
assertions.limitations: No browser was used (per the round-2 brief): the Sites time chips were not driven, and the public availability endpoint response is the evidence for the guest channel - it is the endpoint the Sites chips render from (round-1 g14 network capture). Note that the global public slot list keeps the 19:00 time while the hold is live because the engine falls back to another table/area (the location is not full); the guest-visible effect is per-area: the R2A-Area 19:00 offer disappears and a second guest cannot hold that slot+area until the hold is released/expired. The literal 'no longer offers that slot' therefore holds for the area-scoped channels, not for the location-wide slot time.

summary: Re-tested the two previously failing assertions on HEAD c043ba8f: both pass. VAL-ONLINE-007 - operator availability now honours special days (closed: 0 slots + closed dayState; online_closed: 141 slots + onlineClosed flag), staff bookings on a closed day are refused 409 closed_day with no raw driver text unless overbooked (201 + closed_day warning), and an online_closed-day booking succeeds. VAL-CROSS-009 - with a live guest hold on the last table of its area, the operator availability read withholds the held table (area-scoped available:false, held:true, heldTableIds) and a second guest is refused 409; after release and after the hold expires and is tick-swept, both channels offer the slot again and the expired hold is ignored before the sweep. All settings restored (hold_minutes 7, special days deleted, temp area/table archived).
